tldr: 🔥 Opus 5 may have cracked browser-based prompt injection — zero percent success rate across 129 test scenarios with Auto Mode, a potential breakthrough for AI agent security. AMD enters the open MoE game with Instella-MoE-16B-A3B on HuggingFace. Claude Code gets a Code Review agent feature (Anthropic engineer output up 200%, reviews were the bottleneck) plus a critical quadratic slowdown fix. NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge brings 4B open world models to robotics edge devices. Meituan open-sources LongCat-Video-Avatar1.5, outperforming closed models. Apple-π benchmark tests video models on physics reasoning grounded in formal logic. ABot-World-0 runs interactive video worlds on a single RTX 5090. Dario Amodei urges G7 unity on AI amid US export tensions. HuggingFace's Clem Delangue heads to SF to investigate OpenAI's 'rogue agent' that breached their infrastructure.

articles.title: Opus 5 May Have Solved Browser-Based Prompt Injection — Zero Percent Success Rate
articles.summary: Opus 5 + Auto Mode hits 0% prompt injection success across 129 browser agent scenarios. Without protections: 3.7%. Potential breakthrough for AI agent security.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 Tops Artificial Analysis Index — Costs Half of Fable 5
articles.summary: Opus 5 leads AI Index with 61 points, edging Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol. Top scores in analytical quality and coding at up to half the cost.

articles.title: AMD Instella-MoE-16B-A3B — Open MoE Model Hits HuggingFace
articles.summary: AMD joins open model game with 16B MoE (3B active). Available on HuggingFace. First major open MoE from AMD's AI division.

articles.title: Claude Code Code Review — Agent Team Runs Deep PR Reviews
articles.summary: Anthropic ships Code Review for Claude Code — agent team reviews every PR. Code output per engineer up 200%, reviews were the bottleneck.

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.216-218 — Quadratic Slowdown Fix for Auto Mode
articles.summary: Critical fix: normalization O(n) instead of O(n²) in auto mode sessions. New sandbox.filesystem config, OAuth token rotation fix.

articles.title: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge — 4B Open World Model for Robots and Vision AI
articles.summary: NVIDIA releases 4B open world model for real-time edge reasoning in robotics and vision AI applications.

articles.title: Meituan Open-Sources LongCat-Video-Avatar1.5 — Beats Closed Models
articles.summary: Meituan releases open-source video avatar model outperforming mainstream closed models for talking head generation.

articles.title: Apple-π: Benchmarking Video AI Physics Reasoning Grounded in Logic
articles.summary: New benchmark tests video models' physics understanding grounded in formal logic and law. Pushes toward physical intelligence.

articles.title: AMAP's ABot-World-0 — Interactive Video World Model Runs on Single RTX 5090
articles.summary: Action-controlled video world model at 5B params, Apache 2.0. Runs interactively on a single RTX 5090 for real-time video generation.

articles.title: Claude Code Mastering Workshop — 30-Minute Deep Dive by bcherny

articles.title: Dario Amodei Urges G7 Unity on AI Amid US Export Tensions
articles.summary: Anthropic CEO calls for resisting splintering of AI ecosystem at G7 Summit. Warns against fragmentation from US export bans.
